versions.subject: New Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|startswith:
        - 'HKCR\CLSID\'
        - 'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\CLSID\'
        - 'HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\'
        - 'HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\CLSID\'
    TargetObject|endswith:
        - '\InprocServer32\(Default)'
        - '\LocalServer32\(Default)'
    Details|contains: # Add more suspicious paths and locations
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '\Windows\Temp\'
        - '\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\'
        - '\System32\spool\drivers\color\' # as seen in the knotweed blog
        - '%temp%'
        - '%appdata%'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventType="SetValue" TargetObject IN ("HKCR\\CLSID\\*", "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\\CLSID\\*", "HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\CLSID\\*", "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Classes\\CLSID\\*") TargetObject IN ("*\\InprocServer32\\(Default)", "*\\LocalServer32\\(Default)") Details IN ("*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\Desktop\\*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\Downloads\\*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "*\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\*", "*\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color\\*", "*%temp%*", "*%appdata%*")
